endpoint: Investigator-assessed PFS
result: PFS-INV HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.59-0.96), p=0.019, tafasitamab+lenalidomide+R-CHOP vs placebo+R-CHOP
quote: met its primary endpoint of progression-free survival (PFS) by investigator assessment
notes: Incyte topline press release 5 Jan 2026. Release does not say whether the analysis was interim or final (registered primary completion 2026-09-01).

endpoint: PFS (IRC-assessed), pirtobrutinib+VR vs VR
result: Statistically significant PFS improvement; later coverage: 45% reduction in risk of progression or death (HR ~0.55); no CI in sources read
quote: The study met its primary endpoint.
notes: Lilly release 13 Apr 2026; OS not yet mature. Release does not label the PFS analysis interim or final (registered primary completion 2026-10). The 45% figure is from a later news article; date of that disclosure not confirmed.

endpoint: Overall survival, serplulimab+chemo vs atezolizumab+chemo
result: Median OS 12.4 vs 10.2 months; 24-month OS 32.2% vs 17.6%; median follow-up 14.1 months; no HR, CI or p-value in sources
quote: 斯鲁利单抗组中位总生存期(OS)为12.4个月，优于阿替利珠单抗组的10.2个月
notes: ASTRIDE (HLX10-005-SCLC301E) US bridging study, 201 patients, ESMO 2026 oral; abstracts released 19 Oct 2026. Coverage calls survival benefit '生存获益显著' but gives no test or statement on the primary endpoint; the study hypothesis (superiority vs bridging consistency) not stated. Look for the ESMO presentation for HR/p.

endpoint: PFS, MeziKd vs Kd
result: PFS HR 0.48, p<0.0001; median PFS 18.0 vs 8.3 months (ASCO 2026, median follow-up 10.6 months)
quote: a statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in progression-free survival
notes: BMS topline release cited as dated 9 Mar 2026 (one article's reference link carries 20260308, so 8 Mar is possible); described as interim results. Two-stage seamless design; stage 1 selected 1.0 mg mezigdomide, result is the randomized stage 2 comparison. Full numbers from ASCO 2026 (29 May-2 Jun). BMS release itself not read directly.

endpoint: Co-primary: TAHC change and subject-assessed hair coverage (PRO) at month 6
result: TAHC significant (p<0.05) in both Scalp 1 and Scalp 2 (539% and 168% relative improvement vs vehicle, not attributed by study); PRO significant in one study, trend in the other
quote: One study PRO endpoint reached statistical significance and the other study PRO showed a positive trend.
notes: Cosmo ad hoc release 3 Dec 2025 covering Scalp 1 (NCT05910450) and Scalp 2 jointly. TAHC and PRO are co-primary (Dermatology Times). TAHC met in Scalp 1; whether Scalp 1 is the study with the significant PRO is not stated, so met for this trial cannot be determined. Not 'no' or 'yes' until per-study PRO is disclosed.

endpoint: Percent change in body weight at week 80 (AHI in OSA subset is a second primary)
result: Week 80 weight change (efficacy estimand): -12.7% (4 mg), -19.1% (9 mg), -20.8% (12 mg) vs -4.0% placebo; HbA1c -1.4/-1.6/-1.5 vs -0.2
quote: In both studies, retatrutide met the primary endpoint.
notes: Lilly release 23 Jul 2026 (TRIUMPH-2 and TRIUMPH-3). All three doses met the weight primary per coverage. No p-values given. The AHI primary for the OSA subset (GSA2) was not reported; label rests on the sponsor's statement (rule 3d).

endpoint: Percent change in EASI at week 8 vs placebo
result: Difference vs placebo did not reach pre-specified two-sided significance level 0.025; no numbers given
quote: 사전에 설정된 통계적 유의수준(양측성 0.025)을 충족하지 못한 것으로 확인됐다
notes: Shaperon global phase 2b of NuGel (HY209 gel); first topline disclosed by regulatory filing (gongsi) and company press release on 24 Jun 2026; company launched additional analyses (possible moisturiser/external factors). Itch improvement reported as secondary in later coverage.

endpoint: Maintenance of body weight reduction at week 112 (tirzepatide MTD and 5 mg vs placebo)
quote: continuing tirzepatide at MTD maintained bodyweight reduction and health-related benefits
notes: Lilly release 12 May 2026; ECO 2026 presentation with simultaneous Lancet paper (Horn et al.). No earlier topline found. Numbers from a secondary summary of the Lancet paper, which describes the primary as % change from baseline to week 112 rather than % maintenance of lead-in loss; both arms p<0.0001 vs placebo.

endpoint: Time to second day with GTC seizure over 24-week double-blind period
result: Median time to second GTC seizure day 141 days (opakalim/BHV-7000 75 mg) vs 47 days placebo; 33% vs 0% completed without second GTC day; n=27; no formal test
quote: Formal statistical testing is not provided
notes: Biohaven release 26 May 2026 (read via third-party summary): study closed before reaching pre-specified sample size because of enrolment challenges and portfolio prioritization; 15 active vs 12 placebo; 3-fold prolongation framed positively. Descriptive result without test, so vague rather than stopped_without_result; a reviewer could argue not met.

endpoint: PANSS change at 6 weeks (EEG and eye tracking also listed)
result: Interim (n=16): PANSS total -11.9 vs -5.6 (diff -6.3, no p); positive subscale diff -3.2 (p=0.01); several EEG gamma/alpha measures p<0.05
quote: demonstrated trends indicative of improvement in positive and negative symptoms
notes: Spinogenix release 26 Mar 2026 (SIRS 2026; correction reissue 27 Mar): pre-specified interim analysis of 16 of 32 participants; no statement on whether the primary endpoint was met; no final results found. EEG treated as pharmacodynamic, not efficacy (rule 2); eye tracking not reported.

endpoint: Change in cTnT and CK-MB at 24 hours
result: Median cTnT increase at 24 h ~129% (25 ug/kg) and ~65% (75 ug/kg) vs ~615% placebo; CK-MB change not reported; no p-values
quote: ResoTher Pharma reports strong Phase 2a results for RTP-026 with efficacy signals pointing to less cardiac injury and better cardiac function versus placebo
notes: Release 14 Sep 2026 (via Hunter Capital RTO1): study designed primarily for safety and not statistically powered for efficacy; numerical pattern only, no significance test. Placera page refused (URL length); cision PDF of the same release read instead.

endpoint: Change in functional capacity at week 24
result: Interim: no numbers (Nov 2025); Jan 2026 interim: MFIS fatigue reduction up to 10% vs placebo (p<0.001), n=9; functional capacity not reported
quote: The interim data are highly encouraging and demonstrate that TTI-0102 is well tolerated
notes: Releases do not give the NCT number; matched on sponsor, MELAS, placebo control, Radboud/CHU Angers sites and 6-month final data due Jan 2026. Jan 2026 release calls the study single-blind (record says double-blind). MFIS fatigue is not the registered functional-capacity primary; no final 24-week primary result found.

endpoint: Change in HbA1c at week 36 vs placebo
notes: Two searches (Chinese and English) found no disclosure of this HRS9531 monotherapy phase 3 in T2D; other HRS9531 trials have reported separately.

endpoint: Change in HbA1c at week 20, SHR-3167 vs insulin glargine
result: Week 20 HbA1c -1.37% (2 mg titration) and -1.49% (1.5 mg titration) vs -1.35% glargine; differences -0.02% and -0.14%; no CI or test reported
quote: 治疗20周后，每周一次SHR-3167降低HbA1c与每日一次甘精胰岛素相似
notes: Hengrui disclosed 'positive results' of SHR-3167-201 (matched: vs glargine, oral-agent background, two titration arms) on 4 Jun 2026; EASD 2026 oral presentation (article 9 Oct 2026) not read in detail. No non-inferiority margin or statement that the primary endpoint was met found.

endpoint: Percent change in body weight and proportion with >=5% loss vs placebo
quote: 达成主要终点及所有关键次要终点
notes: BrightGene voluntary SSE announcement 2026-029, posted 5 May 2026 evening (document may carry 6 May date). Company states primary and all key secondary endpoints met; reported weights are at 52 weeks while registered primary is week 36, so the week-36 values were not seen. All doses.

endpoint: HBsAg < 0.05 IU/mL and HBV DNA < LLOQ up to 24 weeks
result: Part A (AHB-137 300 mg weekly x16 wk vs placebo 4:1): complete response 68% (17/25) at end of treatment; functional cure 32% (8/25) 24 weeks off therapy; placebo rate and test not given
quote: a high functional cure rate alongside durable off-treatment viral suppression
notes: EASL Congress 2026 (27-30 May) poster on NCT06829329 Part A; date is the news article's (abstract may have been online slightly earlier). Disclosed before registered primary completion (2026-08-02); other parts (with NAs) not reported. No statement on the primary endpoint or comparison with placebo.

endpoint: Change in DAS28-CRP at week 12 vs placebo
notes: Two searches found only phase 1 healthy-volunteer data (ACR 2025) and trial-registry listings; no phase 2 RA result.

endpoint: EASI-75 and IGA success at week 24
notes: Two searches found MG-K10 phase 3 and 52-week data from other trials and an NDA, but nothing on this phase 2 (NCT07103174).

endpoint: Change in weekly average NRS pain score after 6 weeks vs placebo
quote: 基于该试验的积极结果
notes: Sino Biopharm/Tide announced CDE breakthrough therapy designation for TRD205 on 14 Jul 2026, 'based on positive results' of the completed dose-finding phase 2 in chronic postoperative neuralgia; no endpoint statement or data. allsci.com page refused (robots).

endpoint: Change in peak FEV1 at 4 weeks vs placebo
quote: 亦获得了积极的顶线数据
notes: Sino Biopharm ERS 2026 announcement (7 Sep 2026) says the TQC3721 dry-powder inhaler phase 2 'also obtained positive topline data'; no numbers or endpoint statement. Only one DPI phase 2 identified, so attributed to this trial. Separate phase 2b of the nebulised suspension is a different trial.

endpoint: Semen volume and sperm count at 90 and 180 minutes
notes: CTI tracker (updated 5 Jun 2026) says the phase 2 concluded in May 2026 but reports no results; no other disclosure found.

endpoint: Change in Brief Fatigue Inventory score over 12 weeks vs placebo
quote: Nuvastatic's Success Proves Malaysia's Capability To Develop Therapeutic Innovations
notes: Bernama (21 May 2026) reports the phase 3 RCT of Nuvastatic for cancer-related fatigue in breast cancer as a success, no data; investigator's MASCC post (29 Jun 2026) cites 'successful completion' of the phase 3 in breast cancer. The sponsor has a second phase 3 (TNBC, NCT07669467), so attribution to this trial is uncertain.

endpoint: Proportion with IGF-1 index <=1.0 at week 12, SYHX2008 vs Sandostatin LAR
quote: biochemical control rate demonstrates a trend of being significantly superior to currently marketed
notes: CSPC HKEX voluntary announcement 18 Jun 2026 (US IND clearance) says clinical studies showed onset within one week and a trend to superior biochemical control vs marketed products; does not name this phase 2 or give data. Attributed to this trial as the completed patient study before the China phase 3.
